ck: (7)petasancivini petasananyanityatvasatakEkanunanenEva sarvasvapinatasitirpavatityasayenaha — peta iti atra cantrapetatikanatayanse sitasatanatavaranaya vinata iti puraniyan paksatavacetakan tu prahnacnanetarapatyapetatvan potyan avacetakavacetena tasyatosatve tu petatvanatran paksatavacetakan potyan nanu nityatvanasatvan cetapasitantortakriyakaritvatpatascetyata aha — nityatvan ceti atistaneti yatatnyasvanivartakacnanavisayo(ya)sataranakaro prahnani svarupaneva tatrsananyatra suktitvati(ti) tata ca cnanatvakatitatarnavacinakaranatakatvansapratiyokitvan nityatvananyatsvarupakatanan sukticnanatracatanutsananityatipratitipalatracatasya nasasvikaranasanpava nutkarapatatina katate karanatnanavastanarupatiropava eva na tvansa sa tu prahnacnanenEvetyankikarana tatravyapti atnavisesakunatvenotaracnananivartyapurvecatO nityatvavyavaharavaranaya cnanatvetyati atikan tu tvEtatyunaninanakatatvotyotatipanyan natkrtayananusanteyan petatvena pratiyananatvasyEveti nanu pratiyananatvan (pratitikarnatvan ) katanaprananikasya katate ? tasya sakalasanartyarahitasya karakatvakarpoktakarnatvayokatityata aha — pratiyananatvaniti petatvaprakarakapratitervisayataya hetutvankikaratityarta asato panankikaranasitiriti pava nanu prakapavatisu petatvapranasanpavatatra vyapicara na ca tatrapi nityatvasatvana vyapicara iti vacyan tatatve pratitivisayatvatityetavata purteriti vEyartyatiti cena tatatnyasansarkavacinapetatvaprakaratanirupitavisayatasalitvasya vivaksitatvat petatvena prakapavateranyatraropanataya vyapicarastatavasta iti na sankyan tatrapyaropyananoyan peta iti vyavaharanirvahaya tatra petatvena tatatnyena petapranastatrEva petatvapanasya svikarat tatra caropyananapetasya nityatvena vyapicaraprasakte yatra prakapavo nukyavisesa eva pasate tatra tatatnyena petatvan peta eva pasate tatrsapranepi petanavakahitvan na svikriyate kintvayan peta iti vyavaharapalatpetasya(syEva) prakapave prana tatrEva petatvan pasata ityatyapyupakanana katanapi vyapicarasanka kalikavisayatvatina petatvena tvansacnanatipetanataya vyapicaravaranaya tatatnyasansarkavacineti petatvaprakaratayan nivesa visayatvan ca cnanasataranakaranakaranasanikarsasrayatvan katanasatastatyucyata ityata aha — taceti etatapi tatrkevetyata aha — svarupaneveti cnanasvarupanevetyarta aprananikasya svarupayokatvisayatacnanasvarupaneva tanirupakatvaneva visayasyayan visaya iti vyavaharaheturiti natenetan tatreti putistatanirupakatvaparanarsa prananikatvanapeksanatityakare tata vyavastapitatvatiti pava aprananikatvan ca paran
